name: Straight-Through Estimator (STE) for Gradient Extension
definition: A technique to address zero-gradient regions outside the primitive boundary in the backward pass by decoupling forward and backward passes. The forward pass uses the hard window, while the backward pass uses a smooth surrogate.
summary: The Straight-Through Estimator enables backpropagation through non-differentiable operations by decoupling forward and backward passes, using the actual function forward and an identity mapping backward to extend gradients.
